content_sections.text: The Andhra Pradesh School Education Department has announced 2,721 tentative vacancies through three separate AP DSC 2026 notifications. content_sections.heading: AP DSC Notification 2026 – Three Recruitment Notifications
content_sections.text: The AP DSC 2026 vacancies are divided into three recruitment categories. Candidates should check the notification relevant to their teaching post before applying. These vacancy numbers are tentative. The final vacancies, post-wise breakup, management-wise details and reservation rosters will be published in the detailed notification. Any subsequent changes may be announced through a corrigendum.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Vacancy 2026 – Post Wise Details
content_sections.text: AP DSC 2026 includes 906 School Assistant posts, 1,205 Secondary Grade Teacher posts, 350 Special Education posts and 260 posts in societies. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Recruitment 2026 District Wise Vacancy
content_sections.text: The general teacher and special education notifications provide district-wise vacancies across 26 districts of Andhra Pradesh. Together, these two notifications account for 2,461 posts. Kurnool has 404 tentative vacancies, followed by Prakasam with 291 and YSR Kadapa with 227. The remaining 260 vacancies belong to the societies recruitment notification. That brief notification provides a post-wise total but does not contain a district-wise vacancy breakup.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Special Education Recruitment 2026 – 350 Vacancies
content_sections.text: AP DSC Special Education Recruitment 2026 has 350 tentative vacancies for School Assistant (Special Education) and Secondary Grade Teacher (Special Education) posts in Government, Zilla Parishad, Mandal Parishad, Municipal and Municipal Corporation schools. The recruitment is covered by Brief Notification No. 2/DSC-2026. The detailed notification will provide the prescribed educational and professional qualifications, age limits and other eligibility requirements.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Societies Recruitment 2026 – 260 Vacancies
content_sections.text: AP DSC Societies Recruitment 2026 has 260 tentative vacancies for Principals, Post Graduate Teachers, Trained Graduate Teachers, Physical Directors and Physical Education Teachers. The recruitment covers the Welfare of Differently Abled, Transgender and Senior Citizens Department, MJPAPBCWREIS, APTWREIS (Gurukulam), APREIS, APSWREIS and AP Model Schools managements.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The AP DSC 2026 brief notifications were released on 13 October 2026. The department has stated that the detailed notification will be available on or before 3 November 2026. The application schedule and examination dates will be provided in that notification.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The educational and professional qualifications for AP DSC Recruitment 2026 will be specified in the detailed notification. The brief notifications cover different teaching posts but do not provide the final post-wise eligibility conditions. Candidates should check the detailed notification for their preferred post before submitting an online application. The applicable recruitment rules will be those prevailing on the date of the detailed notification.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limits, eligibility relaxations and related conditions for AP DSC Recruitment 2026 will be provided in the detailed notification. Candidates should check the official notification for the age requirements applicable to their post and category.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The AP DSC 2026 recruitment examinations will be conducted through a Computer Based Test (CBT) with objective-type questions . The examination dates will be announced in the detailed notification. The AP DSC 2026 syllabus is hosted on the official recruitment website. Candidates should refer to the official syllabus and subsequent recruitment instructions for their respective posts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for AP DSC Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Applications for AP DSC Recruitment 2026 will be accepted online through the official website. The application period and detailed instructions will be specified in the detailed notification. Visit the official website at tet2dsc.apcfss.in . Open the AP DSC 2026 detailed notification when published. Read the eligibility conditions and instructions for the relevant post. Follow the online application instructions provided by the department. Enter the required information carefully in the application form. Complete and submit the application according to the official instructions within the specified application period. The department has stated that applications submitted through modes other than online will not be accepted. Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date once the application schedule is announced.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDFs and Important Links
content_sections.text: Three separate brief notifications have been released for AP DSC 2026. Candidates can access the official recruitment portal for the notification documents, syllabus and future application updates.

faq.question: Q1. What is AP DSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AP DSC Recruitment 2026 is the teacher recruitment drive conducted by the Government of Andhra Pradesh School Education Department through the Andhra Pradesh Teacher Recruitment Test (APTRT–2026) for filling School Assistants, Secondary Grade Teachers, Principals, PGTs, TGTs, Physical Directors, and Physical Education Teachers.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are notified under AP DSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2721 tentative vacancies have been notified across three separate brief notifications, comprising 2111 general vacancies, 350 special education vacancies, and 260 vacancies in societies.

faq.question: Q3. When will the Detailed Notification for AP DSC 2026 be released?
faq.answer: The Detailed Notification containing the breakup of vacancies, educational qualifications, age limits, crucial dates, and eligibility conditions will be available on the official website on or before 03-11-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the official website to apply for AP DSC 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can access information and apply online through the official website at https://tet2dsc.apcfss.in.

faq.question: Q5. What mode of application is accepted for AP DSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted only through the online mode via the official portal. Applications sent through any other mode will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q6. Which district has the highest AP DSC 2026 vacancies?
faq.answer: Kurnool has the highest combined district-wise vacancies, with 404 tentative posts under the general teacher and special education notifications, followed by Prakasam with 291 posts.

faq.question: Q7. How many SGT vacancies are available in AP DSC 2026?
faq.answer: There are 1,205 Secondary Grade Teacher vacancies under the general teacher notification and 200 Secondary Grade Teacher (Special Education) vacancies under the special education notification.

faq.question: Q8. How many AP DSC Special Education vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are 350 tentative special education vacancies, including 150 School Assistant (Special Education) posts and 200 Secondary Grade Teacher (Special Education) posts.

faq.question: Q9. How many vacancies are available under AP DSC Societies Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AP DSC Societies Recruitment 2026 includes 260 tentative posts for Principals, PGTs, TGTs, Physical Directors and Physical Education Teachers.

faq.question: Q10. What is the AP DSC 2026 selection examination?
faq.answer: The AP DSC 2026 examinations will be conducted as objective-type Computer Based Tests through APTRT 2026. Examination dates will be provided in the detailed notification.
